caption: Shaun Attwood reveals the dark truth about Bill Clinton. 😳
audio_track_actual: Podcast interview audio — Shaun Attwood speaking on Andrew Gold's 'Heretics' show. No music bed; word-tracking subtitle overlays.
video_overlay_text_observed: A 'Heretics' podcast set: guest Shaun Attwood (bald, checked blazer) mid-interview; a 'heretics' logo top-left, a 'CLINTON BUSH' lower-third, and a title card 'The dark truth about Bill Clinton.'
audio_content_summary: Shaun Attwood, promoting his book chapter, runs through the 'Clinton crime family' thesis: the CIA picked Arkansas and 'the sleaziest, most corrupt governor' to smuggle South American cocaine to fund the Nicaraguan Contras, with Bill Clinton providing state security for the drug drops; his half-brother Roger Clinton was busted in a cocaine sting and recorded saying 'some of this is for Bill, he's got a nose like a vacuum cleaner'; Hillary Clinton hunted down accusers with private investigators, with threats, murdered pets, and people 'thrown off balconies' — 'the genesis of the hashtag Clinton Body Count'; and Arkansas medical examiner 'Fami Malek' adjusted causes of death (because Bill's mother had 'accidentally unalived someone' in the medical profession), ruling shootings and stranglings as drownings.
implied_frame: A dense bundle spanning all three groups. Group A: Roger Clinton's 1985 federal cocaine conviction is real (carded at 1985-roger-clinton-cocaine-001). The Fahmy Malak controversy is real and contemporaneously documented by the Los Angeles Times (carded at 1992-fahmy-malak-001) — Clinton kept a much-criticized state medical examiner whose rulings touched a case involving his mother. Group B: the 'Mena' thesis — the CIA-Contra cocaine pipeline through Arkansas — rests on the real, documented Barry Seal / Mena operations, but no investigation has established Bill Clinton's knowing protection of the flights (adjacent to 1985-iran-contra-001). Group C: the lurid embellishments — murdered pets, victims 'thrown off balconies,' the 'nose like a vacuum cleaner' surveillance quote — are unverified, and the 'Clinton Body Count' framing is already documented as a chain of real deaths with contested or inverted framings (1999-clinton-body-count-reel-001). The reel also miscasts Malak as a 'senator'/'coroner' (he was the state Medical Examiner) and misnames him 'Fami Malek.'
